csd_a11y_settings_exec.description: The executable path or command for the accessibility settings daemon.

csd_a11y_settings_only_show_in.description: Desktop environments in which this application should appear.

csd_a11y_settings_no_display.description: If true, the application is not shown in menus or desktops.

csd_a11y_settings_autostart_phase.description: The phase at which the autostart application should be launched.

csd_a11y_settings_autostart_notify.description: If true, notify the session manager that the application is ready.

csd_a11y_settings_auto_restart.description: If true, automatically restart the application if it crashes.
